card.name: Start of co-, hem-, tri- medical words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a long medical word split into parts, such as co in coagulation, Co in Co-administration or coenzyme, hem in hemodialysis, and Tri in triazolobenzodiazepines.

modes.label: Coagulation and co- words
modes.description: The opening co or Co of coagulation, coenzyme or co-administration.
modes.example: Evaluate patients with signs and symptoms of hemorrhage with<< co>>agulation parameters including PT, PTT

modes.label: Hemodialysis
modes.description: The opening Hem or hem of hemodialysis after words like undergoing, end of, or each.

modes.label: Tri- drug class
modes.description: The opening Tri of triazolobenzodiazepines at the start of a sentence.

card.writes: It seems to push against the word evidence and its variants, with little clear positive effect.
card.plain: It marks the first chunk of long medical words like coagulation and hemodialysis, before the rest of the word is written.
